headline: Technocraft Industries (India) Ltd discloses ESG rating from CRISIL
summary: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited announced its ESG score as assessed by CRISIL ESG Ratings & Analytics. The rating evaluates the company's performance on environmental, social and governance criteria. The disclosure is a regulatory requirement for listed firms and provides transparency to investors. Retail investors may use the ESG score to gauge sustainability and risk aspects of the company.
why_it_matters: ESG score may influence investment decisions
